feeds.title: World of Succulents
feeds.description: A website where you can find plants information, facts and uses, photos, growing tips, stories, where to buy, and more about cacti and succulents.

feeds.title: Succulents and More
feeds.description: My name is Gerhard Bock, and I live in Davis, CA. Follow me as I continue to transform our small suburban lot into a lush yet water-conscious oasis using succulents and perennials.

feeds.title: Debra Lee Baldwin
feeds.description: Debra Lee Baldwin has prepared her succulent blog with information on succulent design, news on succulent plants and designers working with succulents. Succulent book author, expert, 'Queen of Succulents' Debra Lee Baldwin's FAQs, photo galleries, care tips, succulent design ideas, videos, news, more.

feeds.title: Home Garden First
feeds.description: My journey with plants started a decade ago, around 2013, and it's been a delightful adventure ever since. As a female gardener, I've immersed myself in the world of container gardening, relishing the magic of nurturing my plants, fruits, and vegetables. Over the years, my little patch of paradise has grown, much like the seeds I've sown and the knowledge I've cultivated. What began as a simple fascination has blossomed into a full-blown love affair with gardening. Through this blog, I'm excited to share my experiences, tips, and trick

feeds.title: Succulents Box Blog
feeds.description: Covers articles about succulent care, gorgeous succulent varieties, different types of succulents.

feeds.title: Succulent Alley
feeds.description: Looking for a reliable source to buy succulents & cacti online?

feeds.title: Desert Plants of Avalon
feeds.description: My name is Lyn Kimberley and I live in Ireland. This blog is my weird and wacky world of Cacti & Succulents. I have been collecting Cacti & Succulents for over 30yrs and in that time my small windowsill collection of cacti has grown into over 500 Cacti & Succulents.

feeds.title: Sucs for You!
feeds.description: Sucs For You! offers demonstrations of how to propagate and care for succulents and cacti, and other tips on working with these beautiful plants in challenging climates.

feeds.title: The South Coast Cactus and Succulent Society (SCCSS)
feeds.description: The South Coast Cactus and Succulent Society is an affiliate of the Cactus and Succulent Society of America and the California Garden Clubs of California, Inc. (CGCI). It was formed in 1972 to promote an interest in and an appreciation of cacti and other succulents. In addition to learning more about cacti and succulents, club members are encouraged to show and exhibit their plants.

feeds.title: The Art of Succulents
feeds.description: I'm Matt Andrews, a guy with a passion for creative design and a love of plants. Inspiration, tips and advice on Succulent, Cacti and Air Plant care. Home plant display ideas from Terrariums to Kokedama and planters.

feeds.title: The Succulent and Cactus Lady
feeds.description: I am Maree Clarkson, also known as Hedgie and my passions are painting, sketching, gardening and nature. This is a record of my love affair and obsession with cacti and succulents. Come and join in discussions on succulents and cacti and share your passion with the world.

feeds.title: Mountain Crest Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Mountain Crest Gardens™ is a family owned and operated succulent nursery established in 1995, located in the scenic Scott Valley of Northern California near Mt. Shasta. Mountain Crest Gardens specializes in providing a large selection of named individual succulents, hand-picked special collections, and affordable assorted trays with no minimum order or wholesale account requirements.

feeds.title: Succulent Market
feeds.description: Cactus & Succulent Blog on all things cactus & succulents. Succulent Market is the best plant blog on the internet. Learn tips and tricks on cactus & succulent care. In addition, learn about all things cactus & succulents, such as the different types of cactus & succulent plants, and much more!

feeds.title: SucculentCity.com
feeds.description: We started Succulent City as a way to connect with other plant lovers and share our knowledge and passion for succulents. We share lots of succulent knowledge on our blog to help you care for your plants and create the perfect garden! We write new reviews and guides regularly.

feeds.title: Indoor Succulent Care Blog
feeds.description: The Indoor Succulent Care blog exists to help at-home gardeners craft a thriving indoor succulent garden, helping them master topics like watering, soil mixes, potting, and propagating.

feeds.title: Succulents and Sunshine Blog
feeds.description: Succulents and Sunshine website is dedicated to helping you learn more about succulents. This succulent blog covers all the basics of growing and caring for succulents. It also discusses succulent propagation as well as projects you can do!

feeds.title: Succulent Gardens
feeds.description: Succulent Gardens is a wholesale/retail nursery that grows over 400 varieties of quality succulent plants. Succulent Gardens is dedicated to promoting the use of succulent plants to industry professionals and the public through demonstrations, seminars, garden shows and their blog.

feeds.title: The Succulent Eclectic Blog
feeds.description: Your go-to source for succulent care, species information, and succulent DIYs. Authored by Kat McCarthy.

feeds.title: Poppy's Home & Garden
feeds.description: Poppy's Home and Garden is a family owned business that has been operating at Oakdale Road, Gateshead since 2006. Garden Centre, Nursery Newcastle, Plant Nursery, Succulents, Landscape Design, Furniture, Homewares and Cafe etc.

feeds.title: Print A Pot
feeds.description: A small business designing and creating cute and modern pots and planters for air plants, succulents, cacti, houseplants and more.

feeds.title: Spiky obsession
feeds.description: I started growing succulents about 4 years ago and since then they have slowly taken over. My garden is now covered in pots full of succulents and is a very spiky place.

feeds.title: Succulent Sundae
feeds.description: I have a mixed collection of cacti and succulents with an emphasis on mesembs. mainly kept in a greenhouse. I live in S.E. England where the weather is mild but with frost and sometimes snow in winter. I belong to the British Cactus and Succulent Society, Mesemb Study Group and International Asclepiad Society. I attend meetings and shows.

feeds.title: Jack Succulents
feeds.description: Jack grows succulents in Malaysia and in this blog you can find tips on how to take care of them, and occasionally ways to create sweeter homes for your plants.

feeds.title: Succulents Addiction
feeds.description: Follow to get articles on succulents tips, growth guide, tool & resource reviews and much more.

feeds.title: Sublime Succulents
feeds.description: Sublime Succulents is an endeavor started by a US college student. While initially it was an exercise to learn web design, his passion for succulents turned it into something more. Now sublimesucculents.com strives to be not only informational, but also a hub for social interactions and crowd-sourced knowledge!
